data.headline: KLAX: typical arrival delay Thu 21:00 local — median 8 min, 80% within -6…29

claims.text: Over 52 Thu 21:00 hours in the BTS record (Jun 2025–May 2026), median arrival delay at KLAX was 8 min and 80% of hours fell within -6…29 min (~40 arrivals/h). Climatology, not a forecast.

citations.quote: BTS On-Time Performance for KLAX, 52 Thu 21:00 hours from Jun 2025 to May 2026: median arrival delay 8 min; 80% of hours fell within -6 to 29 min (10th to 90th percentile); about 40 arrivals per hour. This is climatology — historical typical values — not a forecast.
